cases.request: Find the proper nouns in First Samuel together with their enclosing clauses.
cases.rationale: Three-node structural embedding plus a proper-noun predicate.

cases.request: Find substantive words annotated as feminine plural.
Find verse and sentence pairs that cover exactly the same slots.
cases.rationale: Explicit same-slot relation independent from containment.

cases.query:
sentence
  c1:clause
  p:phrase
  c2:clause
  c1 << p
  c2 >> p
cases.request: Find sentence patterns with a clause entirely before a phrase and another clause entirely after it.
cases.rationale: Four objects and two long-range order relations.

cases.request: Find consecutive phrase pairs inside a single clause.
Find all word nodes in the Hebrew Bible.
cases.rationale: Type-only request; basis for qere presence/absence partition.

cases.request: Find words that have a qere reading feature.
cases.rationale: Feature presence differs from literal absent string.

cases.request: Find words without a qere feature value.

cases.query: word sp=verb vs#qal vt#infc|infa|ptca|ptcp ps#p3 nu#sg gn#m
cases.request: Find verb words excluding qal, specified infinitive/participle verbal forms, third person, singular and masculine.
cases.rationale: Five separate non-equality predicates with a value set.

cases.request: Find clauses whose dist feature equals integer 1.
Find clauses whose dist feature is below minus ten.

cases.query:
phrase typ=PP
  word sp=prep
  <: word sp=adjv
  <: word sp=subs
cases.request: Find prepositional phrases with a preposition immediately followed by adjective and substantive.
cases.rationale: From MQL tutorial, explicitly BHSA 2017 output: counts must be rechecked on 2021.

cases.request: Find verse–object-clause–word triples where the word at clause start has lexeme >CR.
cases.rationale: From 2017, structural first-slot relation and high-cardinality lexeme.

cases.query:
clause
  phrase function=Pred|PreC
    word sp=verb vs=hif lex=QWM[
  phrase function=Objc
    word lex=BRJT/
cases.request: Find clauses with a predicative hif verb QWM[ and object phrase containing lexeme BRJT/.
cases.rationale: From 2017, complex lexical/morphological joins; no 2021 count asserted.

cases.query:
clause
/where/
  phrase function=Pred
/have/
  /without/
    word sp#verb
  /-/
/-/
  phrase function=Subj
cases.request: Find clauses having a subject phrase where predicate phrases contain verbs only.
cases.rationale: Nested /where/ + /have/ is outside the current QueryIR.

cases.query:
c:clause
/with/
  =: phrase function=Subj
/or/
  := phrase function=Subj
/-/
  phrase
  <: phrase
cases.request: Find clauses having subject phrases at either clause boundary and consecutive phrases.
Find substantives matching a consonantal text regular expression.
cases.rationale: Regex predicates explicitly excluded from first compiler subset.

cases.request: Find W-type clauses with a non-qal verb.
cases.rationale: Regex on typ is outside current compiler subset.
